meta.title: GeoGebra Studio
meta.description: Builds, previews and exports editable GeoGebra 2D/3D constructions from chat. Adds the geogebra_build, geogebra_preview and geogebra_export tools and ships the geogebra-studio skill, so figures can be created, edited in the viewer and exported as TSQX, Asymptote or TikZ. Rendering loads the official GeoGebra engine and needs network access; the plugin writes only new files in the workspace.
